name: gdoc-math
description: Convert Markdown with LaTeX math into a native Google Doc whose equations are real, editable Google Docs equation objects. Uses pandoc (OMML) + gws Drive upload/convert. /gdoc-math takes a .md file, inline content, or the last math content in the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Create Google Docs with native editable equations from Markdown and LaTeX.
interface.longDescription: Convert Markdown with LaTeX math into a native Google Doc whose equations are real, editable Google Docs equation objects. Uses pandoc (OMML) + gws Drive upload/convert. /gdoc-math takes a .md file, inline content, or the last math content in the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Turn this Markdown with equations into a Google Doc.
